description: This file contains test-dependent utilities and mock implementations for the orchestrator package, including a validator that always succeeds, a function to create an execution command that always succeeds, and a function to generate a build source related to Android CI.

classes.name: AlwaysSucceedsValidator
classes.description: A mock validator class that always returns success when validated.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: A method that implements validation and always succeeds.

methods.name: execCtxAlwaysSucceeds
methods.description: Creates an exec.Cmd that always succeeds, regardless of input parameters.

methods.name: androidCISource
methods.description: Generates an Android CIBuildSource with provided buildID and target, encapsulated in a higher-level BuildSource.
